# descope_session_migration (Resource)

Manages the project-level session migration settings for migrating user sessions from another vendor. This is a singleton resource, and its id is always the project ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that these settings belong to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) The API token for the vendor's management API. Only used with the `okta` vendor. This value is write-only and never read back from the server.
- `audience` (String) An optional audience value from the vendor's authentication configuration. Only used with the `auth0` vendor.
- `client_id` (String) The client ID from the vendor's authentication configuration.
- `domain` (String) The domain from the vendor's authentication configuration. Only used with the `auth0` vendor.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer from the vendor's authentication configuration. Only used with the `okta` vendor.
- `loginid_matched_attributes` (Set of String) Which attributes from the vendor's user should be used to match the Descope user's login ID (e.g. `email`).
- `vendor` (String) The vendor to migrate user sessions from, either `auth0` or `okta`. Session migration is disabled when this isn't set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
